summary: The profilePopup function handles the display logic for profile icons based on whether a profile exists or is being accessed. It updates the icon graphics and opens a new window with the provided URL.
purpose: To control the visual representation of user profiles in a UI and trigger profile-related actions.

workflows.name: Profile Popup Initialization
steps: Check if an icon needs to be updated for previous profile.
Update the icon graphic based on profile existence for previous profile.
Set new last profile access value.
Retrieve and update icon for new profile.
Open new window with the URL.

conditions: Check if 'old' is not -1 to determine if there is a previous profile.
Check if profileExists equals 1 to determine the icon state.
